$comment: Refresh policies — defines review cadence, scoring weights, and thresholds for each tier.

A.label: Concepts
A.description: Stable taxonomy definitions. Slow-changing. Human-reviewed only.
triggerConditions: New stratum or axis added to reference model

B.label: Products
B.description: Product metadata, placements, confidence scores. Medium volatility.

C.label: Evidence
C.description: Volatile evidence packets. Replaceable. Expires after TTL.
triggerConditions: New evidence available for same product

scoring.$comment: Refresh priority = weighted sum of 5 factors, each 0.0–1.0. Result is 0.0–1.0.
scoring.formula: priority = (demand × w_demand) + (strategicImportance × w_strategic) + (volatility × w_volatility) + (confidenceDecay × w_decay) + ((1 - trustLevel) × w_trust)

factorDefinitions.demand: How often users search/click this item. Proxy: search hit count or concept page views. 0 = never accessed, 1 = top-5 item.
factorDefinitions.strategicImportance: How central this item is to the {a}OS narrative. 0 = niche, 1 = foundational concept/product.
factorDefinitions.volatility: How fast the external source changes. 0 = stable spec, 1 = weekly releases.
factorDefinitions.confidenceDecay: How much confidence has degraded since last review. 0 = just reviewed, 1 = expired/stale.
factorDefinitions.trustLevel: Quality of the current evidence. 0 = no evidence/unverified, 1 = multiple verified sources. Note: inverted in formula (lower trust → higher priority).
